title: Filament spool holder (IR v1)
prompt: Filament spool holder that sits on a shelf: a 60 x 60 x 5 mm base plate with four M4 clearance holes (4.5 mm) on a 50 mm square pattern, and a 30 mm diameter, 80 mm tall round spindle standing in the middle of the plate, with a 2 mm chamfer on its top edge. Centre it on the origin, Z up, base on Z = 0.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
One printable part: the spindle joined to the plate
Centred on the origin, base on Z = 0
Four 4.5 mm holes on a 50 mm square
The holes are 5 mm in from the plate edges
One conical face: the spindle's top chamfer

notes: IR v1 rewrite of t2-spool-holder: the spindle is joined to the plate (one body), the chamfer is a feature and the holes are an M4 hole feature (ISO 273 normal clearance 4.5).
